title: openflow: validate hello element length in v5 and v6 dissectors
description:
In OpenFlow 1.4 (v5) and OpenFlow 1.5 (v6) hello elements, elem_length includes the 4-byte header. An elem_length \< 4 causes an infinite loop in dissect_openflow_hello_v5() and dissect_openflow_hello_v6() because the offset does not advance.

This follows up on MR !26433 as requested by @alagoutte, adding ei_openflow_v5_hello_element_length_bad and ei_openflow_v6_hello_element_length_bad to report malformed element lengths and safely terminate dissection.

notes.body:
added 2 commits
  • 8901bb22 - 1 commit from branch wireshark:master
  • 0c4279ab - openflow: validate hello element length in v5 and v6 dissectors
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/26444/diffs?diff_id=2018099447&start_sha=25d824c0c3069d6c371578f974b58d31977d8d79)

> . An elem_length < 4 causes an infinite loop in dissect_openflow_hello_v5() and dissect_openflow_hello_v6() because the offset does not advance.

This is clearly an improvement, but I don't believe there was an infinite loop here since the subtraction by 4 did not occur when `elem_length < 4` and thus the offset did advance (having already advanced by 4 prior to reading `elem_length`.

Fair point regarding the loop terminology—since the 4-byte header is read first, the offset does advance rather than stalling at a single position.

The failure mode with elem_length \< 4 was stream desynchronization: it advances by an invalid boundary and attempts to parse arbitrary payload bytes as subsequent hello elements. Adding the length validation and expert info halts dissection cleanly, addressing the existing "/\* Otherwise expert info? \*/" note in the dissector.

commits_data.message:
openflow: validate hello element length in v5 and v6 dissectors

In OpenFlow 1.4 (v5) and OpenFlow 1.5 (v6) hello elements, elem_length includes the 4-byte header. An elem_length < 4 causes an infinite loop in dissect_openflow_hello_v5() and dissect_openflow_hello_v6() because the offset does not advance.

Register and report ei_openflow_v5_hello_element_length_bad and ei_openflow_v6_hello_element_length_bad when elem_length < 4, and safely terminate hello element dissection.
